summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands on software engineering experience across Python and C/C++ spanning machine learning, distributed and parallel systems, and Unix/Linux environments. Built distributed systems from scratch, including MPI based cluster computations on a SLURM managed cluster achieving up to 30x speedup, and shipped multiple machine learning pipelines from data collection through deployment. Uses AI assisted development tools daily to move faster across research, engineering, and debugging workflows.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline for high-resolution generation using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 compared to homography-based stitching baseline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.
Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) across a three-layer distributed pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Achieved up to 10.49x speedup with 12 slave processes on a SLURM-managed cluster; characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths.
Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4-5.5x speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.
Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, achieving 15% WER on a Hindi-English dataset.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
